evidence.note: Chaise backrest is still nearly flat immediately before manipulation.
Backrest is visibly being lifted through an intermediate angle.
Backrest is upright and stable.
Backrest remains upright near the end of the episode.
Chaise is seen returned to a flat configuration.

events.object_description: Adjustable backrest of the white balcony chaise lounge

evidence.note: User is lifting the barbecue's main cooking lid.
Main lid is fully open, exposing the cooking grates.
User grips the open lid to lower it.
Main cooking lid is fully closed.

events.object_description: Main cooking lid of the stainless-steel barbecue grill

evidence.note: Lower cabinet door is still closed.
User swings the lower cabinet door open, revealing the propane tank.
Cabinet door is fully open.
Cabinet remains open at the end of the inspection.
User is closing the lower cabinet door.
Cabinet door is closed again.

events.object_description: Lower propane-storage cabinet door of the barbecue

evidence.note: User reaches toward the barbecue's left-side folding surface.
Large metal side surface is extended horizontally.
Side assembly is being repositioned away from its horizontal deployed state.
The large horizontal surface is no longer deployed; only a narrow upright metal section is visible.

events.object_description: Left-side folding work shelf/panel of the barbecue

evidence.note: Right-side red-labeled shelf is still stowed beside the grill.
User pulls and rotates the right-side shelf outward.
Right-side shelf is horizontal and deployed.
Shelf remains deployed beside the grill.
Shelf is no longer extended and has been stowed.

events.object_description: Right-side folding shelf of the barbecue

notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible. Camera-only survey motion and close inspection of the propane tank were not counted as state changes.
scene_description: A person moves around a residential balcony, adjusts a white chaise lounge, and manipulates several movable parts of a stainless-steel barbecue grill.
